job.job_title: Data Science and Machine Learning Specialist
job.job_description:
Position: Senior AI/ML Specialist Sustainability, Health & Safety

ERM is Senior AI/ML Specialist to lead the development of AI accelerators, intelligent agents, and machine learning models for sustainability, health, and safety domains. The role involves guiding teams in applying LLMs, BERT, and Microsoft Azure AI technologies to design enterprise-grade solutions and drive client impact.

At ERM, we combine deep domain expertise with a strong track record in delivering sustainability-focused digital solutions. Our Digital Services span the full information management lifecycle - from portfolio assessment, strategy, and technology evaluation to the design, testing, and implementation of enterprise-scale systems and cutting-edge technologies.

You will be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven environment that emphasizes technical excellence, scalability, and cross-functional teamwork to deliver solutions that address complex business challenges.

key Responsibilities:
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML solutions, accelerators, and frameworks that address client challenges in sustainability, ESG, and workplace safety.
Hands-on Experience in AI Agent development: demonstrable experience in agentic-AI development using Python, LangGraph, LangChain, and Model Context Protocol.
Architect LLM- and BERT-based applications, ensuring scalability, robustness, and security in enterprise environments.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, engage with senior stakeholders to understand business needs, shape AI/ML strategy, and deliver impactful solutions.
Manage end-to-end AI/ML lifecycle - from solution scoping and data strategy to model development, MLOps, and production deployment.
Mentor and guide junior AI/ML professionals, fostering capability development within the team.
Collaborate with management consulting teams, domain experts, and technology architects to ensure business alignment and technical excellence.
Drive innovation initiatives, identifying opportunities to apply Generative AI, Responsible AI, and sustainability-focused analytics.
Contribute to thought leadership through publications, internal assets, and client workshops.
Ensure adherence to data governance, ethics, and responsible AI principles in all solution deliveries.
key Requirements:
Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or related fields. PhD is a plus.
Experience: 6 8 years of AI/ML project delivery, including at least 2 3 years in leading teams or architecting solutions.
Proven experience in consulting or client-facing environments, with a track record of delivering AI/ML strategy and execution for enterprise clients.
Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills ability to influence CxO stakeholders.
Demonstrated expertise in solution architecture, MLOps, and scaling AI/ML solutions in production.
Deep understanding of sustainability, ESG frameworks, or health & safety data ecosystems is strongly preferred.
Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and team management skills.
Strong business acumen with ability to bridge strategy, technology, and client needs.
Preferred techncial Skills & Tools
AI/ML Frameworks: Advanced experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers (BERT, GPT, LLaMA, etc.).
Generative AI/LLM Engineering: Fine-tuning, prompt orchestration, RAG (retrieval augmented generation), embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Azure Cognitive Search).
Microsoft Ecosystem: Azure AI, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Synapse.
MLOps & Cloud Deployment: MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.
Data & Analytics: Python, R, SQL, Spark, Databricks
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, model governance, bias/fairness testing.
Familiarity with ESG reporting standards (GRI, SASB, ESRS) and safety analytics is an advantage.
Relevant Information:
Industry: Sustainability Consulting Services
Functional Area: Advisory
Role: AI/ML Consultant
Career Level: CL3
Number of Vacancies: One
Location: Bengaluru, Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai

Who We Are:

As the world s leading sustainability consulting firm, ERM is uniquely positioned to contribute to the environment and society through the expertise and energy of our employees worldwide. Sustainability is what we do, and is at the heart of both our service offerings and how we operate our business. For our people, our vision means attracting, inspiring, developing and rewarding our people to work with the best clients and on the biggest challenges, thus creating valuable careers. We achieve our vision in a sustainable manner by maintaining and living our ERM values that include Accountability, Caring for our People, Client Focus, Collaboration, Empowerment, and Transparency.

ERM does not accept recruiting agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ERM employees or any other company location. ERM is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

ERM is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status or disability status.

Thank you for your interest in ERM.
